connector.name: Archiet
connector.registryDescription: Archiet MCP server: scaffold full-stack apps from PRD text and extract capabilities.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package mcp-archiet. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the aniekanasuquookono-web account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ARCHIET_API_KEY
env.description: Workspace-scoped Archiet API key (ak_...). Create one at https://archiet.com/settings/api-keys (Professional plan or higher).

env.name: ARCHIET_API_BASE_URL
env.description: Archiet API base URL. Override for self-hosted or staging deployments.

env.name: ARCHIET_API_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
env.description: HTTP request timeout in seconds. Codegen jobs can take several minutes.
